ov: Kosta Rika, resmî adıyla Kosta Rika Cumhuriyeti, Orta Amerika'da yer alan bir ülkedir. Kuzeyde Nikaragua, kuzeydoğuda Karayip Denizi, güneydoğuda Panama ve güneybatıda Büyük Okyanus ile çevrilidir. Ayrıca Cocos Adası'nın güneyinde Ekvador ile deniz sınırı paylaşmaktadır. Yaklaşık 51,180 km2 (19,761 mil2) bir yüzölçümüne sahip olan ülkenin nüfusu yaklaşık 5 milyondur. Başkenti ve en büyük şehri olan San José'nin nüfusu yaklaşık 350.000, çevresindeki metropolitan alanın nüfusu ise yaklaşık 2 milyondur.

Costa Rica, officially the Republic of Costa Rica, is a country in Central America. It borders Nicaragua to the north, the Caribbean Sea to the northeast, Panama to the southeast, and the Pacific Ocean to the southwest, sharing a maritime border with Ecuador to the south of Cocos Island. It has a population of around five million in a land area of nearly 51,180 km2 (19,760 sq mi); the capital and largest city is San José, home to around 350,000 residents and two million people in the surrounding metropolitan area.

t: San José, Kosta Rika'nın başkenti ve en büyük şehirdir. 1170 metre yükseklikte, bir vadide kurulmuştur. 2000 yılı itibarıyla nüfusu 309672'dir.

San José is the capital and largest city of Costa Rica, and the capital of San José Province. It is in the center of the country, in the mid-west of the Central Valley. San José is Costa Rica's seat of national government, focal point of political and economic activity, and major transport hub.

Kosta Rika'nın taş küreler, Kosta Rika'da, Diquís Deltası'nda ve Isla del Caño'da bulunan üç yüzü aşkın petrosfer çeşididir. Yerel olarak, Las Bolas olarak bilinirler. Küreler yaygın olarak soyu tükenmiş Diquís kültürüne atfedilir ve bazen Diquís Küreleri olarak anılır. Isthmo-Kolombiya bölgesinin en iyi bilinen taş heykelleridir.

The stone spheres of Costa Rica are an assortment of over 300 petrospheres in Costa Rica, on the Diquís Delta and on Isla del Caño. Locally, they are also known as bolas de piedra. The spheres are commonly attributed to the extinct Diquís culture, and they are sometimes referred to as the Diquís spheres. They are the best-known stone sculptures of the Isthmo-Colombian area.
Kosta Rika’nın Pasifik kıyısında, Quepos’un hemen güneyinde küçük bir milli park. Ormanla çevrili plajlarıyla tanınır.

Manuel Antonio National Park is a small national park in the Central Pacific Conservation Area located on the Pacific coast of Costa Rica, just south of the city of Quepos, Puntarenas, and 157 km (98 mi) from the national capital of San José.
Kosta Rika’nın güneybatısındaki Osa Yarımadası’nda yer alan milli park. 1975’te kuruldu; ülkenin en zengin yaban hayatı alanlarından biridir.

Corcovado National Park is a National Park on the Osa Peninsula, in Osa Canton, located on the southwestern regions of Costa Rica, which is a part of the Osa Conservation Area. Corcovado National Park was established on October 24, 1975 and occupies an area of 424 square kilometres (164 sq mi).

n: Area de Conservación Guanacaste World Heritage Site
t: Guanacaste Koruma Alanı, Kosta Rika'nın kuzeybatısında, Guanacaste Vilayetinde yer alan bir Dünya Mirası alanıdır. 2004 itibarıyla 1470 kilometrekare alan kaplamaktadır.

The Area de Conservación Guanacaste is a network of protected areas and a World Heritage Site in Guanacaste Province, in northwestern Costa Rica. The World Heritage Site contains an unbroken tract of tropical dry forest and important habitat for several vulnerable species, including the Central American tapir, mangrove hummingbird, and the great green macaw.
Kosta Rika’nın kuzeydoğusunda, Limón eyaletinde milli park. Yalnızca uçak ya da tekneyle ulaşılır; deniz kaplumbağalarının yuvalama alanı olarak bilinir.

|Tortuguero National Park is a national park in the Limón Province of Costa Rica. It is situated within the Tortuguero Conservation Area of the northeastern part of the country. Despite its remote location, reachable only by airplane or boat, it is the third-most visited park in Costa Rica.
Kosta Rika’nın orta kesiminde, Arenal Yanardağı’nı ve çevresini koruyan milli park.

Arenal Volcano National Park is a Costa Rican national park in the central part of the country, part of the Arenal Huetar Norte Conservation Area. The park protects eight of Costa Rica's 12 life zones and 16 protected reserves in the region between the Guanacaste and Tilarán mountain ranges, and including Lake Arenal.
Kosta Rika’nın Pasifik kıyısı yakınında milli park. 1978’de biyolojik rezerv olarak kuruldu; kızıl ara papağanlarıyla bilinir.

Carara National Park is a national park in the Central Pacific Conservation Area located near the Pacific coast of Costa Rica. It was established on 27 April 1978 as a biological reserve, but its growing popularity after 1990 forced the government to upgrade its category to national park in November 1998.
Kosta Rika’da Poás Yanardağı’nı çevreleyen milli park. Zirve yaklaşık 2.700 metre yüksekliktedir; krater gölü ziyaretçilerin başlıca durağıdır.

Poás Volcano National Park is a national park in Costa Rica that covers an area of approximately 65 square kilometres ; the summit of Poás Volcano located within the park is at an elevation of 2,700 metres (8,900 ft). The park was established on 25 January 1971.
Kosta Rika’nın ortasında, dört eyalete yayılan geniş bir milli park. Başkent San José’ye yakın dağlık yağmur ormanını korur.
Braulio Carrillo National Park is a national park in Heredia Province, Cartago Province, Limón Province and San José Province, in central Costa Rica. It is part of the Central Conservation Area.
Kosta Rika’nın kuzeyinde, adını Tenorio Yanardağı’ndan alan milli park. Turkuaz renkli Río Celeste nehri buradadır.

Tenorio Volcano National Park is a national park in the northern part of Costa Rica, which forms part of the Arenal Tempisque Conservation Area. The jewel of the national park is the Tenorio Volcano, from which it derives its name. The volcano was made part of the National Park in 1995 and is located about 26 miles northeast of Fortuna in the Guanacaste Province.
Kosta Rika’nın kuzeybatısında, Guanacaste eyaletinde milli park. 1966’da kuruldu; ülkenin en eski milli parklarından biridir.
Santa Rosa National Park, is a national park, in Guanacaste Province, northwestern Costa Rica, it was created in 1966 by decree 3694.
